messages.content:
In two or three sentences, explain why a household AI lab might choose to
run a large language model locally on its own hardware instead of only
using a hosted API, even though the hosted API is usually cheaper per
token.

message.content: A local model keeps sensitive data on-site and avoids sending prompts to a third party, which is important for privacy, security, or regulatory constraints. It also provides reliable, low-latency access without API rate limits, network dependence, or long-term token costs, and allows full control over model updates, fine-tuning, and usage policies.
